decisions.reason: As a renamed and previously well-liked trommel screen in a core screening category, it now carries years of sunk investment, installed-base support obligations, and an easy temporary-results explanation, so management would almost certainly continue it.

Although more niche and somewhat exposed by the earlier retreat from other high-speed machines, this green-waste grinder line still fits the mobile recycling portfolio and accumulated commitment over several years makes management more likely to persist than withdraw.

A multi-model stationary pre-shredder line with its own product presence is strategically aligned with tougher recycling requirements and represents a visible commitment that an established German machinery firm would be reluctant to reverse.
